site.title: Hearth Lane Bakery
site.tagline: Slow bread and small cakes, baked in a home kitchen.
site.intro: There's no online checkout: send a message by Thursday evening and collect on Saturday at the market, or Wednesday from the kitchen door.
site.about:
I'm Mira. I bake everything myself in a small licensed kitchen, with flour from a mill two counties over.

The menu changes with the season and with what sells out. If you want something for a birthday, ask a week ahead.

hours.note: Wednesday from the kitchen door; Saturday at the Riverton market. Order by Thursday for Saturday.
